title: Tunable non-Hermitian skin effect and topological phases in ladders with staggered nonreciprocal inter-leg hopping
summary: We investigate the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) and topological phases in a ladder model with staggered nonreciprocal inter-leg hopping, consisting of an Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain coupled to a normal tight-binding chain. By tuning the system parameters, we show that the direction of the NHSE under open boundary conditions can be reversed and can even become energy dependent. The NHSE is further characterized by the spectral winding number under periodic boundary conditions.
